title: Congress workers stage dharna at Rajghat over police action

tea.why: Protesting against Delhi Police action during opposition demonstrations and alleged irregularities in electoral rolls.
tea.want: Demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar and action over alleged vote theft.
tea.changed: Oct 8: Thousands of Congress workers staged a dharna at Rajghat led by Devender Yadav.

summary: Thousands of Congress workers, led by Delhi Pradesh Congress Committee president Devender Yadav, staged a dharna at Mahatma Gandhi's memorial at Rajghat in Delhi. The demonstration was held to protest against Delhi Police action during opposition protests concerning alleged irregularities in the Special Intensive Revision of electoral rolls and the handling of opposition leaders, including Rahul Gandhi. Protesters raised slogans against the BJP-led government and the Election Commission while demanding the resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar. The protest occurred amid heightened security and prohibitory orders imposed by Delhi Police. Meanwhile, BJP representatives criticized the opposition for alleged misbehaviour and disruptions during recent demonstrations.
demands: Resignation of Chief Election Commissioner Gyanesh Kumar
Action over alleged vote theft and electoral roll irregularities
response: BJP spokesperson Praveen Shankar Kapoor alleged that Congress and AAP engaged in misbehaviour during protests and mistreated women police personnel and journalists.

crowd.text: around 300 MPs want to hold a peaceful sit-in

updates.text: Thousands of Congress workers staged a dharna at Rajghat led by Delhi Congress president Devender Yadav.
